copy.title: Shipping Insurance
copy.body: Protect shipments from covered loss, damage, and theft.
copy.status: Point at a stop to send your parcel there

cards.message: Your parcel is looked after at every stop of its journey.
cards.viewerQuestion: Where does InsureShield help along the way?

mapping.object: the teal route filling behind it

cards.breaksDown: A travelling parcel could read as delivery; InsureShield does not deliver. The parcel is the merchant's shipment and the route is the process, never a road.

states.rest: Outline: ghost hairline on the strip, waiting for the parcel
states.active: the parcel travels to the pointed stop, the route fills teal behind it and its tape turns teal
states.meaning: the shipment is covered as it goes
